import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query the highest NO2 value at Causeway Bay station in June 2025
query_no2 = text("""
SELECT datetime, no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 17
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY no2 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")

# Execute the query and get the result
df_no2 = pd.read_sql(query_no2, engine)
peak_no2_timestamp = df_no2['datetime'].iloc[0]
cwb_peak_no2 = round(df_no2['no2'].iloc[0], 1)

# Query the road segments within 300 meters of Causeway Bay station
query_road_segments = text("""
SELECT rs.id, rs.geometry
FROM road_segment rs
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, aqs.coordinate::geography, 300)
WHERE aqs.id = 17
""")

# Execute the query and get the result
df_road_segments = pd.read_sql(query_road_segments, engine)

# Query the mean traffic speed for the road segments at the peak NO2 timestamp
query_speed = text(f"""
SELECT AVG(hrt.speed) AS mean_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrt.datetime = '{peak_no2_timestamp}'
AND rs.id IN ({', '.join(map(str, df_road_segments['id']))})
AND hrt.speed IS NOT NULL
""")

# Execute the query and get the result
df_speed = pd.read_sql(query_speed, engine)
cwb_peak_speed = round(df_speed['mean_speed'].iloc[0], 2)

# Print the results
print(f"cwb_peak_no2: {cwb_peak_no2}")
print(f"cwb_peak_speed: {cwb_peak_speed}")
